doulas.name: Loretta Moore
doulas.credential: Birth Doula, Cornerstone Birthwork Training (2025), Certified Breastfeeding Peer Counselor
doulas.quote: I am a Birth Doula serving families throughout the Chandler, Arizona area and within a 75-mile radius. I believe every birthing person deserves to feel safe, heard, respected, and supported throughout pregnancy, labor, birth, and the early postpartum period.

doulas.name: Brionna Giles
doulas.quote: I'm a community birth doula serving the Phoenix Valley. My goal is to help families walk into their birth experience feeling informed and empowered, and ensure that they are receiving evidence-based and individualized care from every provider on their care team.

doulas.name: Janelle Moore
doulas.quote: DONA Advanced Certified and ProDoula Certified birth and postpartum doula serving the East Valley. Offers antepartum support, newborn care, and full-spectrum birth services.

doulas.name: Grace Lape
doulas.quote: DONA-certified birth doula serving Chandler and the East Valley. Offers birth and postpartum support with a focus on evidence-based care and emotional reassurance throughout the birth journey.

hospitals.name: Chandler Regional Medical Center
hospitals.quote: Chandler Regional's Family Birth Center offers a safe, family-centered environment and we hope to exceed your expectations by fulfilling your educational, physical, psychological and cultural needs.

hospitals.name: Banner Baywood Medical Center
hospitals.quote: Banner Baywood Medical Center is a full-service hospital in Chandler offering labor, delivery, and postpartum care with a Level II NICU. The facility provides a home-like environment for birth with private rooms and comprehensive maternity services.
